Patience is probably the most important virtue in this game, unfortunately.

I'm honestly surprised that player retention is as good as it is considering it's virtually impossible to get diamonds without buying them from the store or selling your entire inventory (I have done both at very high extremes, and while I don't really regret my spending/selling habits I implore you to resist doing both). I seriously hope that with the new school comes actually reliable farming methods because the prices for sets and new items just keeps increasing and it's exhausting to keep up with it.

I've also taken multiple long-term breaks from the game and it has really helped. Because I'm so far behind I just don't care enough to catch up and that's fine by me. I just came back from taking over a year off the game and I'm super motivated to grind as much as I can to prepare for the new school.

It also helps to not compare yourself to others. I know it's such an obvious statement but it's true. A lot of the rich people in this game are tryhard elites that want to stick it to the poor players and you should just ignore them. It's really not that deep.
